name: OWASP_A03_OS_Command_Injection
search: index=web_logs sourcetype="access_combined" | eval payload=urldecode(_raw) | regex payload="(?i)(;\s*(cat|ls|id|whoami|nc|bash|powershell|cmd|wget|curl|chmod|chown)\b|`.*`|\$\(.*\)|\|\s*(bash|sh|cmd|powershell))" | stats count values(payload) as execution_samples by src_ip, uri_path, status
description: OWASP A03: Web sorqularinda emeliyyat sistemi komandalarinin oturulmesini tespit eder.
